answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 33452 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: I am a well-to-do person; I would like to know can I use "Hajj Subsidy" by applying through Hajj Committee? Question: I am a well-to-do person; I would like to know can I use "Hajj Subsidy" by applying through Hajj Committee? Is it allowed in Islam to use the money which is not ours to perform Hajj like in case of "Hajj Subsidy"? Please reply in details. Answer ID: 33452 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1184/765/L=1432) In case of doing hajj through hajj committee, if the government gives some kinds of concession, getting this benefit is lawful for each and everyone. There is no harm in it as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
